pages.november-1-successor-witness.hero..text: The Return, the Referents, and the Addendum

A successor/addendum record that preserves what phrases such as “this thread” refer to, binds the human-supplied ChatGPT thread identity, relates Sabotage I–V without rewriting their sources, and leads to the Entire Matter Return as the Sabotage collection’s consequence/coda while preserving the Return’s separate sealed source authority.
